theme.title: The youngest MVP
theme.subtitle: Chicago Bulls, 2010–11
theme.recap: Derrick Rose led Chicago to the NBA's best regular-season record before the Bulls' deep playoff run ended against Miami.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Derrick Rose's 2010–11 Bulls win?
questions.note: 62 wins, earning the top seed in the Eastern Conference.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Bulls finished the season with a 62–20 record, the best in the league

funFacts.text: Derrick Rose became the youngest player to win NBA MVP, earning the award before his 23rd birthday.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose won the NBA Most Valuable Player Award, becoming the youngest NBA player ever to win the award, at the age of 22.

funFacts.text: Chicago head coach Tom Thibodeau won Coach of the Year in the same season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tom Thibodeau wins NBA Coach of the Year

funFacts.text: Rose led the league's best-record team without a single All-Star teammate.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose won 2010-11 NBA MVP and led his team to the Best NBA Regular Season Record without any All-Star teammates.

questions.prompt: What was Derrick Rose's scoring average in his 2010–11 MVP season?
questions.note: 25.0 points per game alongside his playmaking.

funFacts.text: Rose also averaged 7.7 assists per game during his regular-season MVP campaign.
Rose recorded his first career triple-double against Memphis in January of that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose also had his first career triple-double at the Memphis Grizzlies on Jan 17, 2011.

funFacts.text: His team's offseason additions included Carlos Boozer, Kyle Korver and Ronnie Brewer.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Carlos Boozer | Signed 5-year contract for $80 Million | Utah Jazz

questions.prompt: How many home games did the 2010–11 Bulls win at the United Center?
questions.note: 36 wins at home against only five defeats.

funFacts.text: Chicago finished its regular season with only five home defeats.
The Bulls ended the season by winning every game they played during April.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: April: 8–0 (home: 4–0; road: 4–0)

funFacts.text: The team set a franchise mark for converted three-pointers in a March game against Utah.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On March 12 the Bulls set a franchise record 18 converted 3-point shots

questions.prompt: What did Joakim Noah average in rebounds in the 2010–11 regular season?
questions.note: 10.4 rebounds per game despite substantial time missed.

funFacts.text: Noah underwent surgery for a hand ligament injury and returned late in the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Joakim Noah underwent surgery on December 16 to repair a torn ligament in his right hand.

funFacts.text: Noah appeared in fewer than 50 regular-season games that year because of injury.
He also earned a place on the NBA All-Defensive Second Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Joakim Noah made the NBA All-Defensive Second Team

questions.prompt: How many points did Derrick Rose score in Game 3 against Atlanta in the 2011 playoffs?
questions.note: 44 points, a career high at the time in Chicago's road win.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Derrick Rose scored a career high 44 pts vs the Atlanta Hawks on May 6, 2011.

funFacts.text: Chicago won the game in Atlanta and took control of a competitive second-round series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: May 6 @ Atlanta W 99–82

funFacts.text: The Bulls ultimately eliminated Atlanta in six games to reach the Eastern Conference finals.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: defeated the Atlanta Hawks in six games in the semifinals

funFacts.text: Miami's LeBron James, Dwyane Wade and Chris Bosh later ended Chicago's playoff run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: eliminated by the Miami Heat team led by LeBron James, Dwyane Wade, and Chris Bosh
